translations.web: David’s anger burned hot against the man, and he said to Nathan, “As Yahweh lives, the man who has done this deserves to die!
translations.bsb: David burned with anger against the man and said to Nathan: “As surely as the LORD lives, the man who did this deserves to die!
translations.kjv: And David's anger was greatly kindled against the man; and he said to Nathan, As the LORD liveth, the man that hath done this thing shall surely die:
